decision: Replaced aggregate README percentages with route-specific maturity ranges
why: The same repository contains a usable stock-Haxe route, experimental hxhx routes, and unimplemented plans, so one exact percentage hid the real distance

why: It can skip target preparation without retaining typed compiler objects or inventing a fine-grained invalidation model

decision: Added one immutable final-program snapshot and reused its body observations for the compatibility revision
why: The lookup key needs richer source and configuration authority without a second compiler-sized body walk

decision: Moved the target reuse decision before miss-only OCaml preparation
why: A late probe would repeat the roughly 32-minute work that the warm path must skip
result: target work is not skipped yet; ordering contract passes

decision: Published a redacted request-scoped reuse report with explicit unfinished fields
why: Missing evidence must not look like zero cost or a successful cache
result: report fixture passes; no readiness change

decision: Introduced a bounded opaque in-memory catalog with leases, LRU eviction, reset, and quarantine
why: Future replay needs process-local storage without retaining Haxe typed objects or trusting mutable payload bytes
result: mechanics fixture passes; catalog remains observation-only

decision: Rejected an ordinary macro static as the physical cache owner
why: The actual Haxe 4.3.7 server fixture showed every warm request creating request sequence 1
result: root cause found; no disk-cache fallback introduced

decision: Used Haxe's public persistent macro-runtime marker only on catalog state
why: Upstream eval reinitializes ordinary statics but preserves fields marked persistent in the cached interpreter
result: exact repeat now survives in one realm

decision: Ignored only Haxe 4.3.7's zero-width compiler-owned keep marker on the selected main field
why: The server accumulated duplicate internal markers even though source, typed bodies, output, and behavior were unchanged; user metadata must remain revisioned
evidence: Reflaxe commits 16766aa2db6ad5f31e1bef0958adaf44bccf49e4 and e2f0f81a6e42de920d3fb01b93a3814aedd41fc3; upstream Haxe 4.3.7 src/typing/finalization.ml
result: cold and exact warm request revisions now match

decision: Allowed macro errors either to preserve or replace the interpreter realm, while requiring the next successful request to be exact and internally consistent
why: The actual upstream route preserved the realm for this handled macro failure; safety depends on exact keys and no failed-request admission, not mandatory replacement
result: full reset, error, NoMacroCache, classpath, and restart matrix passes

decision: Ran the clean target-reuse contract with no diagnostic-only callback
why: The permanent gate must prove production-shaped ownership rather than rely on the temporary declaration trace used for diagnosis
result: all catalog, contract, report, probe, and realm markers pass

decision: Confirmed all hxhx Oracle replies are integrated
why: Avoid losing architecture decisions delivered through chat instead of result files
result: Two current packets and one archived server review all map to committed checkpoints and Bead mutations; no outstanding reply found

decision: Closed generated-source runtime and native declaration authority conservatively

evidence: OcamlSourceBundleAuthority; RuntimeCopier; real inspect/scaffold/build/run fixtures; runtime manifest and requirement fixtures
